Hana: quick flag from today's onboarding run of nova-rerank-2b int8: ndcg_all -2.4 pts vs fp16, concentrated on mid-long queries (~400-900 tokens). MRR flat.

Luis: any runtime heuristics enabled? pack/align, kv reorders, anything that might alter tokenization/padding?

Hana: runtime: pack_kv=auto, align_kv=on, per_channel=true, eval_mode=off. command: ./eval_rerank --model nova-rerank-2b --weights q/int8-v3.ckpt --holdout holdout-news-2026 --seed 99 --report ndcg,mrr

Greta: auto packing often flips when avg_seq > 512. That could change padding and cause subtle truncation. Can you run ablation with pack_kv=false + eval_mode=true?

BenchBot: run-summary: run=6190012345 ndcg_all=0.604 ndcg_mid=0.582 mrr_all=0.401 seed=99 duration=47m

Hana: kicked pack_off run now. ETA ~20m.

BenchBot: run-finished: 6190012358 variant=pack_off ndcg_all=0.619 ndcg_mid=0.601 mrr_all=0.402 duration=18m

Luis: pack_off recovers most of the gap. Action: for onboarding, default --eval-mode (heuristics off) and add a token-length parity smoke where any padding/truncation diffs >0.5% fail the run. Also document sequence-triggered packing in the runtime docs.

Greta: I'll add a short CI test that diffs token lengths on a small random sample and post a PR. Hana please attach top-k diffs for mid-long bucket to the ticket.

Hana: will do. closing for now — thanks folks.
